explanation: A revelation or disclosure that Jesus Christ gave to show his servants what must soon take place.
The eternal, infinite, and all-ruling God who is the source of all things.
The Son of God, the Messiah and Savior who was raised from the dead to reign over the kingdom on earth.
Those who serve God and Jesus Christ through faith and obedience in the church.
The Holy Spirit or the Spirit of God, who acts as a messenger between heaven and earth.
Seven specific Christian communities in Asia (Asia Minor) that received the letter from John with warnings and exhortations.
Something that belongs to or comes from the divine realm, heaven.
The physical world where people live and where God's plans are to be fulfilled.
The concept that God will judge all people based on their deeds at the end of time.
